question.text: Which one of the following statements in relation to the hydrogen atom is correct?

options.text: $3 s, 3 p$ and $3 d$-orbitals all have the same energy.
$3 s$ and $3 p$-orbitals are of lower energy than $3 d$-orbital.
$3 p$-orbital is lower in energy than $3 d$-orbital.
$3 s$-orbital is lower in energy than $3 p$-orbital.

solution.text: The hydrogen atom has the configuration $1 s$ and $3 s, 3 p$ and $3 d$-orbitals will have same energy with respect to $1 s$-orbital.
